$comment: Machine-readable SAFE/PROTECTED policy for the PageLoom Autonomous Development Manager. See automation/README.md for how this is used. Unknown/ambiguous tasks MUST default to PROTECTED (see defaultClassification).

safe.description: Task categories the manager may execute without asking Isaac first, per the issue's AUTONOMOUSLY ALLOWED list.

protected.description: Categories that always require a fresh, explicit, current-turn approval from Isaac, per CLAUDE.md and the issue's HARD SAFETY BOUNDARY. Matching ANY keyword/path/label below classifies the whole task PROTECTED, even if other parts look safe.

enforcementNotes: This policy is a pre-filter that decides whether the manager is allowed to hand a task to Claude Code at all. It is not the only safety layer.

CLAUDE.md's production deployment safety gate is loaded automatically in every Claude Code session in this repository and independently blocks any production-changing command (firebase deploy, gcloud/IAM writes, gh secret/variable set, direct prod Admin SDK writes) unless the CURRENT turn contains fresh, explicit, scope-specific approval. A SAFE classification here never substitutes for that gate.

The manager itself never runs deploy/IAM/secret commands directly — it only posts @claude comments on approved issues/PRs (reusing the existing .github/workflows/claude.yml trigger) and reads GitHub state. It has no Firebase/GCP credentials and no repository-secret write access.
If a task matches both safe and protected signals, PROTECTED wins.
If classification cannot be determined with confidence, treat the task as PROTECTED (fail closed).
